import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { createRequire } from 'node:module';
import path from 'node:path';
import test from 'node:test';
import { initialModerationView } from '../src/account-moderation/controller';
import { initialAdminPostRemovalView } from '../src/admin-post-removal/controller';
import { initialAdminDiscussionRemovalView } from '../src/admin-discussion-removal/controller';
import { initialProfileModerationView } from '../src/profile-moderation/controller';
import { initialProfileAvatarModerationView } from '../src/profile-avatar-moderation/controller';
import { initialStudentView } from '../src/verification/student-controller';
import { initialFeedbackNoticesView } from '../src/pages/feedback-notices/controller';
import { withModerationDetails } from '../src/pages/admin-post-removal/presentation';

type Node =
  string | { tag: string; attrs: Record<string, string>; children: Node[] };
type Element = Exclude<Node, string>;
type Action = {
  tag: string;
  attrs: Record<string, string>;
  ancestors: Record<string, string>[];
};
type Fixture = {
  id: string;
  page: string;
  patch: Record<string, unknown>;
  expectedText: string[];
};
const require = createRequire(__filename);
const { parsePreviewWxml: parse } = require('../scripts/preview-wxml.mjs') as {
  parsePreviewWxml(source: string): Element;
};
const { render: renderNodes } = require('../scripts/smoke-ratings.mjs') as {
  render(
    nodes: Node[],
    data: Record<string, unknown>,
    templates: Record<string, Element>,
  ): Node[];
};
const fixtures = (
  require('../scripts/fixtures/moderation-preview.mjs') as {
    default: Fixture[];
  }
).default;
const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '../src');
const read = (file: string) => readFileSync(path.join(root, file), 'utf8');
const source = (page: string, extension = 'wxml') =>
  read(`pages/${page}/${page}.${extension}`);
function defaults(page: string): Record<string, unknown> {
  const base = {
    detailsExpanded: false,
    historyExpanded: false,
    addressError: '',
    punishmentKind: 'none',
    punishmentUnit: 'days',
    punishmentValue: '7',
    punishmentReason: '',
  };
  if (page === 'admin-post-removal')
    return { ...base, ...initialAdminPostRemovalView() };
  if (page === 'admin-discussion-removal')
    return { ...base, ...initialAdminDiscussionRemovalView() };
  if (page === 'profile-moderation')
    return { ...base, ...initialProfileModerationView() };
  if (page === 'profile-avatar-moderation')
    return { ...base, ...initialProfileAvatarModerationView() };
  if (page === 'student-verification-review')
    return { ...base, ...initialStudentView() };
  if (page === 'feedback-notices')
    return { ...base, ...initialFeedbackNoticesView() };
  return {
    ...base,
    ...initialModerationView(
      page === 'safety-appeal-management'
        ? 'appeal-management'
        : 'punishment-management',
    ),
  };
}
function document(page: string) {
  const templates: Record<string, Element> = {};
  const collect = (file: string): Element => {
    const tree = parse(read(file));
    for (const node of tree.children) {
      if (typeof node === 'string') continue;
      if (node.tag === 'import')
        collect(path.join(path.dirname(file), node.attrs.src!));
      if (node.tag === 'template' && node.attrs.name)
        templates[node.attrs.name] = node;
    }
    return tree;
  };
  return { tree: collect(`pages/${page}/${page}.wxml`), templates };
}
const flatten = (nodes: Node[]): Node[] =>
  nodes.flatMap((n) =>
    typeof n === 'string' ? [n] : [n, ...flatten(n.children)],
  );
function render(page: string, patch: Record<string, unknown> = {}) {
  const { tree, templates } = document(page);
  return flatten(
    renderNodes(tree.children, { ...defaults(page), ...patch }, templates),
  );
}
const text = (nodes: Node[]) =>
  nodes
    .filter((n) => typeof n === 'string')
    .join(' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
const elements = (nodes: Node[]) =>
  nodes.filter((n): n is Element => typeof n !== 'string');
const actions = (nodes: Node[], handler: string) =>
  elements(nodes).filter(
    (n) =>
      n.attrs.bindtap === handler ||
      n.attrs.bindinput === handler ||
      n.attrs.bindchange === handler,
  );
const fixture = (id: string) => fixtures.find((f) => f.id === id)!.patch;
for (const f of fixtures)
  test(`${f.id}: strict fictional semantic markers`, () => {
    assert.ok(f.expectedText.length > 0);
    const output = text(render(f.page, f.patch));
    for (const marker of f.expectedText)
      assert.ok(
        output.includes(marker),
        `${f.id}: missing ${marker}\n${output}`,
      );
    assert.doesNotMatch(
      output,
      /undefined|\{\{|<template|匿名|评论|https?:\/\//,
    );
    assert.doesNotMatch(
      JSON.stringify(f),
      /evidenceSrc":"[^"\s]+|https?:\/\/|wxfile:|tmp\/|private\/|storageKey|downloadUrl/,
    );
  });
function inventoryOf(template: string): Action[] {
  const out: Action[] = [];
  const walk = (nodes: Node[], ancestors: Record<string, string>[] = []) => {
    for (const n of nodes) {
      if (typeof n === 'string') continue;
      const guards = Object.fromEntries(
        Object.entries(n.attrs).filter(([k]) =>
          ['wx:if', 'wx:elif', 'wx:else', 'wx:for', 'wx:for-item'].includes(k),
        ),
      );
      if (
        Object.keys(n.attrs).some(
          (k) =>
            k.startsWith('bind') ||
            k.startsWith('catch') ||
            k === 'url' ||
            k === 'open-type' ||
            k === 'disabled',
        )
      )
        out.push({
          tag: n.tag,
          attrs: Object.fromEntries(
            Object.entries(n.attrs).filter(
              ([k]) =>
                k.startsWith('bind') ||
                k.startsWith('catch') ||
                k.startsWith('data-') ||
                [
                  'url',
                  'open-type',
                  'disabled',
                  'maxlength',
                  'type',
                  'value',
                  'checked',
                ].includes(k) ||
                k.startsWith('wx:'),
            ),
          ),
          ancestors,
        });
      walk(
        n.children,
        Object.keys(guards).length ? [...ancestors, guards] : ancestors,
      );
    }
  };
  walk(parse(template).children);
  return out;
}
const audit = JSON.parse(
  readFileSync(
    path.join(__dirname, 'fixtures/moderation-action-inventory.json'),
    'utf8',
  ),
) as { before: Record<string, Action[]>; after: Record<string, Action[]> };
for (const [page, after] of Object.entries(audit.after))
  test(`${page}: exact payload, disabled and ancestor-guard inventory`, () => {
    const actual = inventoryOf(
      page.startsWith('safety-')
        ? read('pages/safety-appeal-management/management.wxml')
        : source(page),
    );
    assert.deepEqual(actual, after);
    const existing = actual.filter(
      (a) =>
        !['onToggleDetails', 'onToggleHistory'].includes(a.attrs.bindtap ?? ''),
    );
    const canonical = (list: Action[]) =>
      list.map((a) => JSON.stringify(a)).sort();
    assert.deepEqual(canonical(existing), canonical(audit.before[page]!));
  });

test('disclosures only change transient display state, never controller facts or confirmation', () => {
  const updates: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
  const controller = { sentinel: true };
  const page = withModerationDetails({
    data: { busy: true, frozen: true, canDecide: false, confirming: 'cancel' },
    controller,
  });
  page.onToggleDetails.call({
    data: page.data,
    setData: (patch) => updates.push(patch),
  });
  assert.deepEqual(updates, [{ detailsExpanded: true }]);
  assert.equal(page.controller, controller);
  assert.equal(page.data.frozen, true);
  assert.equal(page.data.canDecide, false);
});

test('content removal stays exact-target, frozen-safe and explicitly confirmed', () => {
  for (const [page, fixtureId, entry] of [
    ['admin-post-removal', 'moderation-post-ready', 'onRemovePost'],
    [
      'admin-discussion-removal',
      'moderation-reply-ready',
      'onRemoveDiscussion',
    ],
  ]) {
    const ready = fixture(fixtureId!);
    assert.equal(actions(render(page!, ready), 'onSubmit').length, 0);
    assert.equal(
      actions(render(page!, { ...ready, frozen: true }), entry!).length,
      0,
    );
    assert.equal(
      actions(render(page!, { ...ready, management: null }), entry!).length,
      0,
    );
    assert.equal(
      actions(render(page!, { ...ready, busy: true }), entry!)[0]?.attrs
        .disabled,
      'true',
    );
    const unknown = render(page!, {
      ...ready,
      management: null,
      frozen: true,
      pendingRequestId: 'fictional',
    });
    for (const h of ['onRecover', 'onRetry', 'onCancelRequest'])
      assert.equal(actions(unknown, h).length, 1);
  }
});

test('unavailable profile capability never exposes a mutation or fabricates a preview', () => {
  for (const [page, key, action] of [
    ['profile-moderation', 'nickname', 'onResetNickname'],
    ['profile-avatar-moderation', 'avatar', 'onClearCustomAvatar'],
  ]) {
    const out = render(page!, fixture(`moderation-${key}-unavailable`));
    assert.equal(actions(out, action!).length, 0);
    assert.equal(actions(out, 'onSubmit').length, 0);
    assert.equal(elements(out).filter((n) => n.tag === 'image').length, 0);
  }
});

test('safety capability, reason, busy, frozen and selected-case guards stay independent', () => {
  const appeal = fixture('moderation-appeal-detail');
  const readOnly = render('safety-appeal-management', {
    ...appeal,
    canDecide: false,
  });
  assert.equal(actions(readOnly, 'onRequestDecision').length, 0);
  for (const lock of [
    { busy: true, reason: 'filled' },
    { frozen: true, reason: 'filled' },
    { reason: '' },
  ]) {
    const out = render('safety-appeal-management', { ...appeal, ...lock });
    assert.equal(actions(out, 'onRequestDecision').length, 3);
    assert.ok(
      actions(out, 'onRequestDecision').every(
        (n) => n.attrs.disabled === 'true',
      ),
    );
    assert.equal(actions(out, 'onSubmit').length, 0);
  }
  const release = render(
    'safety-punishment-management',
    fixture('moderation-punishment-readonly'),
  );
  assert.equal(actions(release, 'onRequestRelease').length, 0);
  for (const page of [
    'safety-appeal-management',
    'safety-punishment-management',
  ]) {
    const out = render(page, {
      frozen: true,
      hasSession: false,
      pendingRequestId: 'fictional',
      selectedAppeal: null,
      selectedPunishment: null,
    });
    for (const handler of ['onRecover', 'onRetry', 'onCancelRequest'])
      assert.equal(actions(out, handler).length, 1);
    assert.match(text(out), /失去管理权限仍可恢复本账号原请求/);
  }
});

test('student expiry and current evidence capability gate preview, with cleanup and original recovery intact', () => {
  const expired = render(
    'student-verification-review',
    fixture('moderation-student-expired'),
  );
  for (const handler of ['onPreview', 'onApprove', 'onReject'])
    assert.equal(actions(expired, handler).length, 0);
  const locked = render('student-verification-review', {
    ...fixture('moderation-student-queue'),
    pending: true,
  });
  assert.equal(actions(locked, 'onApprove')[0]?.attrs.disabled, 'true');
  assert.equal(actions(locked, 'onReject')[0]?.attrs.disabled, 'true');
  assert.equal(actions(locked, 'onRecover').length, 1);
  assert.equal(actions(locked, 'onCancelRequest').length, 1);
  assert.match(source('student-verification-review'), /关闭并清除材料/);
  assert.match(source('student-verification-review'), /材料有效期/);
  assert.match(source('student-verification-review'), /不能审核自己的申请/);
});

test('feedback unavailable rows remain non-actionable and read acknowledgement stays explicit', () => {
  const out = render('feedback-notices', fixture('moderation-feedback-list'));
  assert.deepEqual(
    actions(out, 'onOpen').map((n) => n.attrs.disabled),
    ['false', 'true'],
  );
  assert.equal(actions(out, 'onRead').length, 1);
  const policy = render(
    'feedback-notices',
    fixture('moderation-feedback-policy'),
  );
  assert.match(text(policy), /不会自动标记已读/);
});

test('all eight pages are local, scoped, accessible materials without generic hero banners', () => {
  const css = read('pages/admin-post-removal/moderation.wxss');
  assert.match(css, /min-height: 88rpx/);
  assert.match(css, /var\(--wu-surface/);
  for (const page of Object.keys(audit.after)) {
    const json = JSON.parse(source(page, 'json')) as {
      usingComponents: Record<string, string>;
    };
    assert.equal(json.usingComponents['wu-icon'], '../../components/icon/icon');
    assert.doesNotMatch(
      source(page),
      /WHALEU|eyebrow|class="title"|https?:\/\//,
    );
    assert.doesNotMatch(
      source(page, 'wxss'),
      /community\/forms|account-moderation/,
    );
  }
  assert.doesNotMatch(
    source('safety-appeal-management'),
    /account-moderation\/screen/,
  );
  assert.doesNotMatch(
    source('safety-punishment-management'),
    /account-moderation\/screen/,
  );
});
